AI Overview
Globle is a daily geography guessing game where you try to identify a hidden "Mystery Country" on an interactive 3D globe. 
Globle
 +1
How to Play
Make a guess: Type the name of any country into the search bar to start. 
Read the color clues: Each incorrect guess colors that country on the globe based on how close it is to the target. White or cooler shades mean you are far away, while warmer colors (yellow, orange, and deep red) mean you are getting closer. 
Globle
 +2
Check the stats: Every guess provides the exact distance in kilometers and a compass direction pointing toward the mystery country. 
No limit: You have unlimited guesses to find the daily country. 
Extra Modes
Globle: Capitals: Test your knowledge by guessing world capital cities instead of countries.

 +1
Practice Mode: Play extra games beyond the single daily puzzle.
